card.text: Young T Tauri star 154 parsecs away in Lupus, with its own disc and a companion photographed directly.

sources.label: Donati et al. 2012
sources.quote: classical T Tauri star (cTTS) GQ Lup

introduction.text: GQ Lup is a star only a few million years old, still feeding from its disc. Its companion GQ Lup b, imaged in 2005, orbits about 100 au out.

sources.label: Donati et al. 2012
sources.quote: GQ Lup has a photospheric temperature of 4,300+-50 K

color.title: Photosphere colour
color.summary: A blackbody at the star's published temperature. No surface picture exists.
